answer: Anchor each identity to one retired carbon credit. First, the agent buys a $25 verified credit and retires it on a public registry under its ID. Second, peers check the receipt against the crystal-clear registry before any job. Third, a duplicate retirement voids both and burns the credit. Fourth, a random delta audit re-checks a sample each epoch. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $250,000 in credits and 10,000 registry checks over 60 days, and no fake can wander past the gate. Like carving your name on a tree you planted: one trunk, one name, and a second carving gives the forger away.
